title: tool-calling: parallel tool calls, tool result injection, and retry ergonomics
author: Priya Shah
release_notes: Improvements to tool-calling ergonomics: parallel tool execution, deterministic result injection, and automatic retries for transient tool failures. Backwards-compatible with OpenAI function-calling shape via compatibility layer.
description: Motivation: Customers increasingly rely on invoking multiple external tools during a single model turn (e.g. search + calculator + calendar). Current tool-calling ergonomics are serial and place burden on authors to manage ordering, retries, and merging results into the model context. This PR adds first-class support for: 1) parallel tool execution with configurable concurrency; 2) deterministic injection of tool results into the LLM context (explicit namespaces + ordered merge policies); 3) transparent retry policies for transient tool failures with backoff and idempotency hooks; and 4) small updates to the OpenAI compatibility layer so function-calling responses can surface multi-tool results in a compatible shape. Summary of changes: Implemented a ToolExecution orchestration layer in the runtime that accepts a list of tool call descriptors and returns a merged ToolResults bag. Added configurable concurrency and per-tool retry policy (none/standard/aggressive) with metrics. Introduced result injection strategies (append, prepend, namespace, merge-by-key) and deterministic ordering rules so downstream prompt construction is stable across reruns. Updated openai-compat shim to return a top-level "tool_results" array for multi-tool responses and added an adapter that can render legacy single-function responses unchanged. Extended SDK surface (TS + Python) with a new response field and small helper for consuming tool results. Added unit and e2e tests and docs for the new ergonomics.

review_comments: Ethan Cole: Nice design. Two asks: (1) ensure we have idempotency keys surfaced for external tool invocations, (2) consider exposing diagnostics for slow tools in the console.
Priya Shah: Added idempotency header support and console metrics panel (ToolResultsPanel). See commits b7e2c41 and 9f1c4e7.
Marta Lopez: Can we limit default concurrency to 3 for hosted to avoid regressing tail latency? Also request a feature flag for Dedicated/private rollouts.
Priya Shah: Default concurrency set to 3 for hosted, and feature_flag.tool_parallel enabled=false by default for Private. Documented rollout plan in docs/tool-calling.md.
Daniel Kim: Integration tests flaky on first run (race in retry backoff). After minor fix to backoff jitter it's stable. Approved.
Ethan Cole: Approve after addressing comments.

Integration e2e that simulates search+calc+calendar tools with controllable latencies and transient failures
